title: Top Latch Blumcraft
description:
Blumcraft is CRL's long-standing panic device brand, now facing new competition. Its top latch had a recurring field problem: a 3° angle on the strike let the roller pop out under enough pressure. The latch also wasn't as universal as it should be, and electric-strike compatibility was limited. A competitor's fix for the electric-strike issue added cost and narrowed door compatibility.

Rather than buy an off-the-shelf part, our team at CRL designed a new security latch in-house. Its back plate keeps the roller engaged under exterior pull force, and it fits more door configurations. The design is patented, with CRL's VP of Engineering, Mirjana Komadina, named on the patent. It ships with every new Blumcraft panic device order for fast market penetration, and it passed Gate 4 in February 2025.

brief.label: Problem
brief.text: The top latch could fail under enough pressure, and figuring out model compatibility was unclear and slow for customers.

brief.label: Solution
brief.text: A CRL-designed, patented security latch with a back plate that keeps the roller engaged, combining the best of our previous design and the competition's.

brief.label: Customers
brief.text: Glaziers, architects, glass temperers and door repair shops.

brief.label: Value
brief.text: A more secure and more universal latch at a lower cost than competing options, simplifying inventory for customers and for CRL.

brief.label: Design
brief.text: Designed in-house by CRL's engineering and product team, and patented with Mirjana Komadina, VP of Engineering, as inventor.

Retrofit sales through service centers and door repair shops
swot.threats: Competitors may try to design around the patent

my_role: I co-led the Blumcraft security latch with the senior product manager through Gate 4. I documented the field failures, compared our design with the competition's fix, and worked with our engineering team as they designed and patented the new latch. I also set the plan to ship it with every new panic device order.

challenges.challenge: First articles of our new latch design had to be approved before the production run, with the manufacturing supplier waiting on our answer.
challenges.resolution: Engineering inspected the first articles dimensionally the week they arrived, and all three variants were approved for production.
